{"id":1894678649,"question_id":581,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1769194855,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1894678649/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Shortest Unsorted Continuous Subarray","memory":"31.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int findUnsortedSubarray(vector<int>& nums) {\n        vector<int>copy = nums;\n        sort(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n\n        int min_len = INT_MAX;\n        int l = 0 , r = nums.size()-1;\n        while(l < r)\n        {\n            if(copy[l] == nums[l] and copy[r] == nums[r])\n            {\n                l++; \n                r--;\n            }\n            else if(copy[l] != nums[l] and copy[r] == nums[r]) r--;\n            else if(copy[l] == nums[l] and copy[r] != nums[r]) l++;\n            else \n            {\n                min_len = min(min_len , r - l + 1);\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        return min_len == INT_MAX ? 0 : min_len;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"shortest-unsorted-continuous-subarray","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1537}
